faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a Government-recognized Medical College in Assam and be registered with the Assam Medical Council (AMC) to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer (MBBS) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 38,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the NHM Assam Medical Officer (MBBS) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official NHM Assam website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this Medical Officer (MBBS) position?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post is on a contractual basis, as indicated in the official notification released by NHM Assam.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer (MBBS) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer (MBBS) post involves an online application, followed by the preparation of a merit list and online counselling.
